message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a red border on the left and bottom edges. Centered is a caricature of a man with spectacles, light skin, and dark hair. His cheeks are inflated, and his mouth is stuffed with several small, translucent, shrimp-like creatures. His right hand, wearing a dark band on the ring finger, is raised toward his chin. A similar translucent shrimp floats in the background to the left. The background is a soft, hazy landscape of water and sky in muted pink and gray tones.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO" over "E N A K  D I B A C A". Above it, smaller text says "SENGKARUT DATA KORBAN COVID-19" and "IKHTIAR LOKAL MENANGKAL CORONA". On the left, bold black text reads "PESTA BENUR MENTERI EDHY", followed by smaller black text describing lobster seed export. At the bottom right are a barcode, "6-12 JULI 2020", "RP 45.000", and other publishing details. A QR code is in the bottom left corner.
